tables.name: categories
tables.schema:
CREATE TABLE categories (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                title TEXT,
                num INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                parent_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
            )

tables.name: hadeeths
tables.schema:
CREATE TABLE hadeeths (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                title TEXT,
                hadeeth TEXT,
                explanation TEXT,
                
                hints TEXT,
                hadeeth_ar TEXT,

                grade TEXT,
                attribution TEXT,
                tarteeb INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                ar_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1

            )

tables.name: category_hadeeth
tables.schema:
CREATE TABLE category_hadeeth (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                category_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                hadeeth_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories (id),
                FOREIGN KEY (hadeeth_id) REFERENCES hadeeths (id)
            )
